title: Hold an authority to generate or transmit electricity
what: Construct or operate generating works only under a generation licence, and a transmission system only under a transmission licence (or an integrated regional licence for either).

sources.title: Electricity Industry Act 2004 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not construct or operate generating works except under the authority of a generation licence or an integrated regional licence

sources.title: Electricity Industry Act 2004 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not construct or operate a transmission system except under the authority of a transmission licence or an integrated regional licence

sources.title: Electricity Industry Act 2004 (WA)
